set.body: Define CSV exports for every supported baseline scalar and structured comparison, pair score, reduction, contrast, temporal bin and model prediction. Preserve trial keys, units, method and parameter identity, exclusions, failures, realized denominators and source/plan hashes. Provide base-R consumption checks and Arrow IPC only under its JVM owner. Exit when all baseline guides consume exported artifacts without bespoke in-process bridges.
set.title: Complete reusable baseline result exports
